records.name: part1.yz_projection_count
records.note: Grid count of the quarter disk against the closed form pi*r^2/4.

records.name: part1.xz_projection_count

records.name: part1.xy_projection_count
records.note: Grid count of the xy triangle against the closed form r^2/(2m).

records.name: part1.volume_count
records.note: Count of one random point per cell of a 240-cube grid against the closed form r^3/(3m).

records.name: part1.volume_monte_carlo
